entityDescription:
ROVIAL is a visionary startup based in Toulouse (France) developing High-Power Space platforms in high orbits that will significantly increase the amount of electrical power available in space at a fraction of today’s cost. Rovial High-power Platforms roadmap starts with 100KW satellites and incrementally goes up to Hundred-MWs power platforms.Initially, Rovial power will be used in orbit, with clients’ equipment hosted in our space platform. There are clients, markets, and needs existing today for this. In the long-term, the power could be “sent” remotely to other satellites, the Moon or the Earth through microwaves or lasers.
To do so, Rovial is developing groundbreaking AI-enabled robotics for in-space assembly of the required orbital structures, and other key enabling technologies. The first platform will be a 100KW robotically assembled PVA satellite, which will only require one single launch to service. This will be the most powerful single object ever launched in history and it will revolutionize all the businesses and applications in MEO/GEO such as hosted payload, space teleports, LEO constellation relay, etc…. It will also anticipate the first applications of space data centers, intensive data processing, high-power space lasers, ultra-high-throughput distant communications (Moon & Mars), in-space manufacturing, resource processing (e.g. space mining), and later orbiting power plants.
As the roadmap evolves, Rovial will deliver increasingly more power and will gradually incorporate a radically new power generation Technology, Solar Thermal, for which Rovial has advanced engineering (solar concentrator based on mirrors, space turbine, inflatable radiator). Once developed, this technology breakthrough would allow to scale power to the MWs range in an immensely clean, radiation-resistant way and at a radically low marginal cost per KW.

entityName: University Research Institute of Urban Environment and Human Resources  Panteion University, Athens
entityDescription:
The Institute of Urban Environment and Human Resources (UEHR) was founded in 1995 under the Department of Economic and Regional Development of Panteion University. It is a legal person governed by public law and is subject to the legislative status of the Research Institutes Law Decree 2083/92. UEHR is a result of the evolution of the Laboratory of Geographical Information Systems, founded in 1989 by the Department of Urban and Regional Development of the Panteion University.
The main areas of dedicated activities of the Institute are: Education - Research - Scientific Publications - Scientific Workshops - Research Projects. The Institute contributes to undergraduate and postgraduate education within and beyond the Department of Economic and Regional Development of the Panteion University and is “a place for hosting” doctoral and postdoctoral researchers. The key focus areas of the Institute's activities are: Urban Environment, Urban Planning and Human Resources, Economic Dimensions of the Urban Environment, Sustainable Cities, Real Estate Market, Natural Resources and Ecosystem Services, Environmentally Sustainable Economic Development, Management of Water Resources and the Socioeconomic aspects of Climate Change in urban and rural contexts.

description:
SpaceTech is an independent German medium size enterprise operating in the space sector. With a deep passion for space we offer a wide spectrum of products and services for space missions - from earth observation, navigation and science to new space mega-constellations.

Our main capability is the design, development and production of innovative, high quality and cost effective space equipment and subsystems. We offer smart product solutions for satellite platforms as well as for photonic and quantum technology space payloads. We kept our start-up spirit over the years, which gives us the freedom to think outside the box and to discover new ways in the space industry.

SpaceTech is also a competent partner for the definition and optimization of satellite systems and space missions. We are able to provide complete design, production, verification and launch solutions for small satellite systems.
With several solar arrays, electronics and mechanisms as well as optical instruments - fully operational in orbit - SpaceTech can demonstrate ample space heritage and is successful both in institutional and commercial space activities.

FlySight is the new spin-off company of Flyby S.r.l. dedicated to the Defence&Security and to the Infrastructure Asset Management market sectors. 
This company inherits years of Flyby experience in satellite remote sensing and optical image advanced analytics.
FlySight team is specialized in designing and developing cutting edge software in the field of C4ISR (Command, Control, Computer, Communication for Intelligence Surveillance and Reconnaissance) systems andapplications in civil infrastructure asset management.
The proposed solutions are based on AI (Artificial Intelligence) approaches, exploiting the latest cognitive signal processing and adaptive image fusion algorithms. As an example, 
FlySight adopts deep learning methodologies together with Augmented Reality technologies to make it possible to define disruptive ISTAR (Intelligence Surveillance Target Acquisition and Reconnaissance) systems.
Real-time PED (Processing Exploitation and Dissemination) solutions are possible due to the integration of FlySight company proprietary products in the customers’ already existing IT architectures, thanks to the interoperability of FlySight systems with STANAG and OGC (Open Geospatial Consortium) standards.
Typical applications are in the avionics , naval and underwater fields, and energy production plants, electric grid and oil&gas infrastructure monitoring in order to provide an improved geospatial situational awareness for both the ground segment and for the on-board image acquisition platform.

description:
pro-beam Group is a leader in the field of electron beam and laser technology. The company provides services and systems for the welding, hardening, perforating and coating of surfaces to a wide range of industries: from automotive and aerospace to semiconductor and nuclear sectors. In addition, the company operates in the field of additive manufacturing and is developing corresponding manufacturing processes for industrial applications. Depending on their requirements, customers can opt for contract manufacturing at pro-beam or for their own customer-specific pro-beam plants.

For over 45 years, customers from over 40 countries have been trusting in pro-beam solutions. The group is represented by five locations and more than 350 employees worldwide. Headquarters are in Gilching (near Munich), Germany and act as development center for future topics like e-mobility.
For further information please visit: https://www.pro-beam.com/en/

About electron beam welding
As part of pro-beam’s R&D work in recent years, the company has been able to significantly advance the technology of the electron beam. Today pro-beam can weld 100% digitally, automate and reproduce processes and control the quality of the welded components. In addition, companies using the electron beam are highly flexible in terms of process design and construction. They are also able to weld cleanly, with a high welding speed and in a single step without the need for reworking.

The electron beam creates narrow, deep and parallel welding seams, joins different metals and creates minimal stress and distortion.

entityDescription:
The goal of SpaceLabEU is to develop technologies, which make VLEO (very low Earth orbit) accessible. This tremendous task requires a disruptive change in propulsion technology and material properties, rather than incremental research and development. We have therefore developed a prototype of an air-breathing electric propulsion drive which is currently being tested in laboratories together with Czech Airspace Research Centre in Prague. The drive, which is unique across Europe, is yet to be tested in real-life environment, i.e. in space.

SpaceLabEU brought together a team of experts from various fields – plasma dynamics, electromagnetic systems design, mission analysis and business development. Together, we are not just creating a propulsion system or a platform for VLEO, but also are enabling entirely new business cases and offering qualitative improvements to the existing ones.
Our research isprivately funded at the moment and we areconstantly looking for new research partnerships or investment opportunities.

LTCalcoli, since 1996, is offering engineering numerical analysis services using Finite Elements Method aimed at designing, evaluating, improving and optimizing structures of varying complexity. 
LTCalcoli supports the engineering activities of the Customers for: 
• ELECTROMAGNETIC analysis of low and high frequency devices and magnetic devices, evaluating magnetic field distribution as well as eddy currents with the related Maxwell and Lorentz forces.
•	THERMAL ANALYSIS
•	STRUCTURAL and THERMO-STRUCTURAL ASSESSMENT; 
•	FRACTURE MECHANICS
• VIBRO-ACOUSTICS (including fluid-structure coupling);
• Analysis and design of COMPOSITE MATERIALS;
• Structural design of Formula1 Chassis parts;
• METALFORMING and WELDING DISTORTION evaluation; 
• Buckling and post-buckling 
• Highly nonlinear material behaviour 
• High-speed dynamics
LTCalcoli expertise in numerical analysis can support industries in the design, assessment and optimization of simple and complex structures, with the final objective of improving product performance and/or reducing development times and costs.
LTCalcoli team is involved in the design analysis of several components of nuclear fusion reactors: 
• ITER • IGNITOR (High Field Tokamak machine)
• W7-X (IPP Stellarator) • JET
 • FTU (CR ENEA Tokamak Upgrade)	• DEMO 
LTCalcoli can also design and manage the preparation of OPERATIVE PROTOTYPES as a complement to the numerical analyses, for their validation, tuning, refinement and testing.
LT Calcoli is offering a cloud service LTCloud®, for performing FE analysis on cloud.

entityDescription:
The Portuguese Space Agency, Portugal Space is an organization created by the Portuguese government to implement the National Strategy for Space (Portugal Space 2030). The Agency’s primary purpose is to promote and strengthen Space in Portugal, its ecosystem and value chain, for the benefit of society and economy in the country and worldwide, acting as a business and development unit for research entities and companies.
Portugal Space coordinates the Portuguese participation in several international organisations such as the European Space Agency (ESA) and advises the Portuguese government on the contributions and subscriptions made to ESA. Portugal Space also coordinates the Portuguese participation in European Southern Observatory (ESO), in the European Solar Telescope (EST) and in the recent SKAO (Square Kilometer Array Organization) as a founder member. Portugal Space is also the national representative for Portugal to the European Commission for matters related to Space, namely the European Union Space Program (Copernicus, Galileo, GOVSATCOM, SSA) and Horizon Europe and has a seat in the Board of the EUSPA.

entityDescription:
Compusult Europe B.V. was formed in 2019 as a wholly owned subsidiary of Compusult Limited. Compusult Limited was formed in 1985 as a computer consulting firm with a primary focus on the development of scientific applications to support environmental data acquisition and management. From that beginning, Compusult is now a global leader in geospatial Interoperability. We market a suite of standards based applications offering revolutionary solutions for geospatial data discovery, access and delivery. These data management solutions are built around our core software system, Web Enterprise Suite, a turnkey system able to pull together diverse data holdings and systems.
Compusult's complete solutions also include many advanced workplace adaptation products incorporating assistive technology specifically designed for the visually impaired and for systems monitoring. In addition, Compusult provides computer consulting, programming and integration services to government, business, technical and scientific sectors.

entityDescription:
Datlas is a Secondary Establishment (Business Unit) of Oxalis created by 4 researchers in October 2021 and specialised in 2 different fields = the altimetry/surface currents inversion field (methodological and algorithmic developments of inversion products from space observations) and the arctic sea ice field (implementation of short term sea ice forecasts and production of derived indicators)
Datlas is based on a balance of technical and scientific skills = 
- Inversion and assimilation techniques
- Inter-comparison of methods and data-challenges
- Numerical modelling and HPC skills (ocean, sea ice)
- Data handling and processing
- Treatment of uncertainties, probabilistic/ensemblistic approaches
